recommendation.capacity_reason: All six candidates leave 702–840 pending job-day observations unstarted within Day D. None satisfies the requested healthy operating/service region; even B75 leaves 515712 offered GPU-hours unserved. This is demonstrated system burst/backlog inadequacy, not missing preassigned sites.
recommendation.next_review: Resolve peak/backlog-service design intent before selecting installed capacity. Keep WAN/D24 contract issues separate; no additional untested capacity or policy is applied.
